summary: Nora can now check who said something in the messages she is already looking at, before she puts words in anybody's mouth.
details: A new who_said tool answers "who said this" from the conversation window already in her prompt, and returns the speaker's name with the line itself.
It completes the recall ladder: who_said searches what she was just shown, load_transcript reads older messages from the conversation, and search_memory reaches back further still.

Her doctrine already required her to find the line before saying "you said X". For a line inside the visible window that check left no trace at all, so a verified attribution and an invented one looked identical afterwards; it is now a recorded call with its own counter and trace span.
When the window cannot be read, she is told she could not check rather than that nobody said it.
limitations: It only searches the messages currently in front of her. Anything older needs load_transcript or search_memory, and the tool's own answer says so.
Matching is on the words as written — a paraphrase will not find the line.
